description: UniProt search for a fused DABA-aminotransferase/decarboxylase in V. cholerae and KT2440
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"
U="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"

def q(query, size=30):
    r=requests.get(U, params=dict(query=query, format="tsv", size=size,
        fields="accession,protein_name,length,gene_names,organism_name"), timeout=30)
    if r.status_code!=200 or not r.text.strip(): return pd.DataFrame()
    lines=r.text.strip().split("\n"); hdr=lines[0].split("\t")
    return pd.DataFrame([l.split("\t") for l in lines[1:]], columns=hdr).assign(
        Length=lambda d: pd.to_numeric(d["Length"], errors="coerce"))

pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",58)
B=q('(organism_id:243277) AND (protein_name:diaminobutyrate)')
C=q('(organism_id:160488) AND (protein_name:diaminobutyrate)')
D=q('(organism_id:243277) AND (length:[700 TO 1300]) AND (protein_name:decarboxylase)')
print("V. cholerae N16961, diaminobutyrate proteins:")
print(B[["Entry","Protein names","Length","Gene Names"]].to_string(index=False) if len(B) else "  none")
print("\nP. putida KT2440, diaminobutyrate proteins:")
print(C[["Entry","Protein names","Length","Gene Names"]].to_string(index=False) if len(C) else "  none")
print("\nV. cholerae N16961, decarboxylases 700-1300 aa (would contain the fusion):")
print(D[["Entry","Protein names","Length","Gene Names"]].to_string(index=False) if len(D) else "  none")

L=[]
for df,org,c in [(B,"V. cholerae","#3A6EA5"),(C,"P. putida","#B03030")]:
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        g=(str(r["Gene Names"]).split()[0] if r["Gene Names"] else r["Entry"])
        L.append((f"{org} {g}", r["Length"], c))
L=[x for x in L if not np.isnan(x[1])]
if L:
    L=sorted(L, key=lambda x:x[1])
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,0.5*len(L)+3.0))
    ax.barh([x[0] for x in L],[x[1] for x in L], color=[x[2] for x in L])
    ax.axvline(750, color="k", ls="--", lw=1.5)
    ax.text(760, 0.0, "a DABA-AT + DABA-DC fusion\n(PMID 19196710) would fall here", fontsize=9.5)
    for i,x in enumerate(L): ax.text(x[1]+8, i, f"{int(x[1])} aa", va="center", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1000); ax.set_xlabel("protein length (aa)", fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title("No fused diaminobutyrate aminotransferase/decarboxylase is annotated in either genome\n"
                 "blue V. cholerae N16961, which demonstrably makes 1,3-diaminopropane and sym-norspermidine (PMID 19196710);\n"
                 "red P. putida KT2440. The positive control is invisible to KO annotation, so absence of ddc in KT2440 is weak evidence.",
                 fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
    for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(L, columns=["protein","length","colour"]).to_csv(f"{OUT}/daba_fusion_search.csv", index=False)
